title: Flower bunny origin
body:
## Powers
### Bunnykin
- You can run faster and jump 3 blocks (Toggle with primary).
### Hydrophobia
- Being in water slows you down and make you nauseous
### Flower power
- Consuming different types of flowers give you different effects...(Listed in-game)
### Thick fur
- Your thick fur protects you from freezing. You can walk on powder snow (Requires MobOrigins)
### Tunneller
- You break soft blocks faster with your bare hand and don't take suffocation damage
### Vegan
- You cannot eat meat or damage animals
### Vulnerable
- You take more damage from mobs

## Final notes
- As always, join the discord if you want to report bugs or give suggestions. I will implement most of them if they're reasonable.
- Original concept by internetnekoo.
